text:
anya: Heads up — CI is red for hosted integration tests: auth + streaming + tool-calling are failing in staging.

sara: I see the failures, repros: tests/integration/test_tool_call.py::test_tool_auth_retry and tests/integration/test_stream.py::test_stream_timeout. Failing mostly on shard 3.

michael: Logs show intermittent 401s from hosted-auth. Locally token service returns 200. Might be header normalization or splitting.

anya: Tried a quick local run: `pytest tests/integration/test_tool_call.py::test_tool_auth_retry -q` — it hangs on the handshake, then eventually 401. Paste of truncated log: `AuthResponse(status=401) token: 'ey..'`

dev-bot: Pipeline notice: shard-3 job failed with exit code 1 — https://ci.internal/12345 (attached logs).

oliver: @anya @sara can someone trigger a rerun on shard 3? I'm about to step into another meeting.

sara: Rerun requested: `ci rerun 1955001234 --shard 3` :hourglass_flowing_sand:

oncall-bot: Rerun queued for shard 3 (executor id exec-77).

michael: Rerun finished: auth tests passed on shard 3, but streaming still flaky. Example stack: 
``` 
TimeoutError: stream read timeout after 30s
  at streaming_handler (/src/streaming/handler.py:212)
  at connection_manager.handle_stream
```

anya: Streaming timeout correlates with the proxy header normalization rollout from yesterday (deploy-ops). Suspect the proxy sometimes strips the `Authorization` header when multi-value headers are rewritten.

sara: Can we bisect between last green build (1954900000) and the current head? I can kick off CI bisection if folks agree.

michael: Good plan. Also add `--log-level debug` to the client and a `curl -v` against the auth endpoint to capture headers.

anya: Minimal repro curl I used: `curl -i -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://hosted-api.staging.redwood/v1/stream` — response intermittently 401, sometimes 200.

oliver: Could this be related to token refresh timing? We changed refresh window in the deploy earlier this week.

sara: I opened a quick PR to increase the stream client timeout to 60s and add header debug logs (link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/PR/789). If bisection shows the proxy is the cause we'll still need rollback.

michael: I'd prefer bisection first, but +1 on the PR as a temporary mitigation if production is impacted.

anya: Starting CI bisection now: `ci bisect --from 1954900000 --to 1955001233 --targets integration` — will post updates.

dev-bot: CI bisection started (bisection id bisect-904). Jobs: 1954930001..1954990005.

anya: Bisection result: commit a1b2c3d (proxy header normalization) is the first bad commit. Rolling back that change locally makes streaming tests pass.

sara: Confirmed locally too — rollback of proxy header normalization -> tests green.

oliver: Rolling back the proxy change in staging now (rolling restart of proxy group-2). ETA ~7m.

oncall-bot: Staging rollback complete, health checks OK.

michael: Action items: add regression tests for header pass-through, add end-to-end auth header assertion in integration harness, and adjust metrics/alerts for stream timeouts. I'll draft a short postmortem blurb.

sara: Created ticket INF-452 to add the regression tests + monitoring (https://issues.internal/INF-452).

anya: Thanks all — big win. Please add any follow-ups to INF-452. :thumbsup:
